exceptions.reason: Malformed Host can alter request.url.path, but SwitchTrade uses it only for structured logging; authorization and routing do not depend on the reconstructed URL.
Neither the relay nor localhost control API parses request.form() or application/x-www-form-urlencoded bodies.
SwitchTrade does not make trust or authorization decisions from request.url.hostname or request.url.netloc.
SwitchTrade has no FileResponse or StaticFiles routes, so the vulnerable Range parsing path is unreachable.
SwitchTrade has no StaticFiles mount; the hosted relay also runs in the Linux container defined by relay/Dockerfile.
SwitchTrade registers FastAPI function routes and has no HTTPEndpoint subclasses.
The affected shared-UNIX-host /tmp scenario is absent: tests run on isolated developer machines and ephemeral single-job GitHub-hosted runners, never a shared test service.
